_doc: The Tern's bot crew (openspec/changes/crew-npcs, design 1 and 7; read by sc-core::crew::CompanyData). Departments in the order bots leave as players join (the last first). `count` is with one player aboard; `rooms` are layout compartment ids the department works in; a bot walks between places in them and stays at each for a time drawn from `stay_s`. `division` is the department's division, whose `colour_srgb` is its tunic (sRGB 0-1) and its marker on the map (ship-plan-view): operations gold, science blue, engineering red, support green, from the owner (2026-10-11, openspec/changes/crew-uniforms).
